Generate complete production-ready PHP MCP server using official PHP SDK. Ask project name (e.g. `my-mcp-server`), description, transport (stdio/http/both), tools, resources/prompts, PHP version (PHP 8.2 or higher required).

Composer: `"name": "your-org/{project-name}"`, `"description": "{Server description}"`, `"optimize-autoloader": true`, `"preferred-install": "dist"`, `"sort-packages": true`.

Implement as applicable: `#[McpTool]`, `#[McpResource]`, `#[McpPrompt]`, `#[McpResourceTemplate]`, `#[Schema]`, `#[CompletionProvider]`. Use `declare(strict_types=1);` in all files, PSR-12, PHPDoc for all methods, parameter schema validation, clear specific exceptions. Always use PSR-16 cache for discovery in production.

Include greet (`Hello, {$name}!`); arithmetic add/divide with `Division by zero` and `Invalid operation` exceptions; `config://app/settings` JSON resource; `data://{category}/{id}` JSON template; code-review/documentation prompts; simple action, emai
